name: Adlerhorst-Panoramasteg am Achensee
beschreibung:
High above the turquoise Achensee, on the summit of the Gschöllkopf in the Rofan mountains, stands the Adlerhorst at 2,039 metres above sea level – one of Tyrol's most spectacular viewing platforms. The hand-forged steel structure, crafted by Jenbach blacksmith artist Manfred Hörl, resembles a genuine eagle's nest: a circular metal lattice roughly eight metres in diameter and weighing 15 tonnes juts boldly over the ridge, offering a 360° panoramic view across the Karwendel, the Rofan range and the deepest lake in Tyrol.

Route & Requirements

The path to the Adlerhorst starts at the top station of the Rofan cable car at around 1,840 m – right next to the historic Erfurter Hütte (1,831 m). The trail first follows broad gravel and alpine tracks past the Mauritzalm, then climbs via switchbacks through mountain pine and rocky steps to the summit. The route from the top station is around 2.5 km (approx. 1.2 km each way) with around 200 metres of ascent and descent. Allow 1.5 to 2 hours for the full round trip from the cable car station.

The trail is rated a moderate mountain hiking path (difficulty T2, red markings). Surefootedness and sturdy mountain boots with good grip are essential. When wet, the rocks and metal grating of the platform become extremely slippery. Those with a fear of heights should note that the platform is open and airy, with a direct view down through the lattice.

Season: The platform is accessible only during the snow-free summer season. The Rofan cable car generally operates from late April to early November, with main season hours (mid-June to mid-September) of 08:00–17:30 daily (as per official Rofanseilbahn AG timetable). Entry to the platform itself is free; the cable car costs approximately €30.50 return for adults, €18.50 for children.

Getting There

The valley station of the Rofan cable car is in Maurach am Achensee (Achenseeweg 10, 6212 Maurach). By car: from the A12 Inntal motorway, take the Wiesing/Achensee exit and follow the B181. Large car parks (Rofan cable car 1 & 2) are right at the valley station; parking fees are refunded with a cable car ticket. By public transport: take ÖBB/DB to Jenbach, then the VVT regional bus (line 4080, approx. 15 minutes) to the stop „Maurach Rofanseilbahn“. In summer, the historic Achensee rack railway also runs from Jenbach.

Tips

  • Children: Suitable from around age 5–6 with some hiking experience. The summit path is not pushchair-friendly – child carriers recommended for toddlers.
  • Dogs: Allowed on the cable car with lead and muzzle required. Lead required on the trail due to grazing cattle. The open grating of the platform is unsuitable for most dogs (fear of heights, claw hazard).
  • Thunderstorms: The metal structure on the ridge is a lightning risk – descend immediately if a storm approaches!
  • Combination: Pair the Adlerhorst with a stop at the Erfurter Hütte or a walk to the Dalfazalm. The Tyrolean Eagle Trail (Tiroler Adlerweg) also passes through the Rofan area.
